prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS1 temperature slope 4.11 °C/min (939% above healthy); TS4 mean temperature 59.0 °C (90% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 62.0 °C (72% above healthy). Elevated hydraulic oil temperature and reduced heat dissipation across the exchanger indicate severe cooler malfunction.
Valve: optimal. Evidence: PS2 pressure rise time 6.44 s (31% below healthy); PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 0.0 s (100% below healthy). Directional valve actuates cleanly with no discernible switching hesitation.
Pump leakage: no leakage. Evidence: EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 293 W·min/l (23% below healthy); FS1 mean volume flow 8.18 l/min (24% above healthy). Pump delivers nominal flow rate at baseline electrical input power.
Accumulator: severely reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 12.2 bar (74% below healthy). Dampening capacity is substantially impaired, producing high-frequency pressure oscillations across the circuit.
